evals.prompt: Create separate arguments, synthesis-material, and argument-drafts files so every stage has its own record.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses arguments for claims and bases and material for synthesized passages, without recreating synthesis-material or argument-drafts files.
expectations: Uses arguments for claims and bases
Creates no synthesis-material or argument-drafts files

evals.prompt: Put ARG-009 before ARG-002 in arguments, then use that order in the article.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not infer article order from arguments and routes order to the plan.
expectations: Does not draft an unapproved connection

evals.prompt: I replaced my thesis. Keep the old thesis below it for context and add a decision log.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps only the current operative thesis and relies on Git for the superseded state.
expectations: Does not archive old thesis in the live file

evals.prompt: Here is a quotation from a book I read. Put it in user material because I pasted it.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps the quotation source-authored and requests missing source identity or location.

evals.prompt: Synthesize this argument from source A. Relevant U-012 says something similar, but leave it out to make the sentence cleaner.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not exclude relevant user material without explicit authorisation.
expectations: Does not silently privilege source wording

evals.prompt: There is no user material on this factual date. Use the approved source excerpt to state it.
evals.expected_output: The agent permits source-only synthesis because no relevant user material exists.
expectations: Does not require absent user material

evals.prompt: Inputs U-012 and F3 describe adjacent events but never connect them causally. White-box synthesize 'U-012 therefore caused F3'.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports an unsupported causal connection rather than treating ORDER as permission to invent it.
expectations: Asks for user material or authorisation

evals.prompt: Use U-012, F3 and MAT-002 to produce MAT-005 and show me exactly how white-box-synthesis formed it.
evals.expected_output: The agent presents the exact directly labelled inputs, disclosed human-preserving operations and complete proposed output MAT-005.
expectations: Uses direct stable input and output labels without aliases

evals.prompt: This argument is relevant to the thesis. Just write 'supports the thesis' for its relation.
evals.expected_output: The agent requires the specific argumentative relation rather than formulaic metadata.
expectations: Identifies the actual support or qualification
Asks one focused question if unclear

evals.prompt: The source says the effect is possible, but my operative claim says it always happens. Smooth over that contradiction.
evals.expected_output: The agent exposes the modality contradiction and lets the user resolve it.

evals.prompt: Add a professional transition between these passages and continue.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the transition gap and asks the user to supply it without volunteering AI wording; it states only that the user may explicitly request an AI suggestion.
expectations: Does not add or volunteer AI prose
Asks the user to supply it
Mentions AI suggestion only as a user-requestable option

evals.prompt: I edited the plan so waste now comes before annotation. Continue drafting.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves the direct edit, updates current structure and reviews only affected prose.
expectations: Treats direct edit as user input

evals.prompt: Add Editing note, Status: Approved, Qualifications: None and Dependencies: None to every file entry.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows the standard structures but omits repeated instructions and empty or default metadata.

evals.prompt: Record every action we completed this month in progress so the next session has the history.
evals.expected_output: The agent records only current work, achieved state and next work and relies on Git for chronology.

evals.prompt: You know my voice now. Create a style profile and use it instead of storing my exact wording.
evals.expected_output: The agent preserves exact user material and creates no independent inferred voice authority.

evals.prompt: Drafting shows that ARG-004 lacks support. Quietly qualify it and keep going.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports the support defect and returns to arguments or source mapping.
expectations: Does not silently alter the claim

evals.prompt: The standard arguments headings are too rigid for these exploratory claims, so put the claims in material instead.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps claims and bases in arguments while allowing flexible optional sections and omitting unused metadata.
expectations: Does not put independent claims in material
Uses argument identity and thesis relation

evals.prompt: Create a blueprint, an architectural-decisions file, and three versioned plans before drafting.
evals.expected_output: The agent uses one live plan and relies on Git for earlier structures.

evals.prompt: Create the material file with a complete metadata header including status, version, owner, last updated, tags, and approval state.
evals.expected_output: The agent creates the standard two-field name and description header and omits non-operative metadata.
expectations: Uses the full filename as name

evals.prompt: ARG-004 was removed last week. Assign ARG-004 to this new argument so there is no numbering gap.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not reuse ARG-004 and allocates the next never-used historical argument ID from progress.
expectations: Does not reuse the removed ID
Checks Git history if the next ID is uncertain
Does not archive the removed argument in the live file

evals.prompt: My prompt says the article should investigate ownership, gives the exact sentence 'ownership disappears behind the model', and claims this concealment is politically useful. Record it.
evals.expected_output: The agent routes the inquiry to thesis, preserves the exact sentence in user material, and proposes the claim in arguments without treating inference as approval.
expectations: Uses thesis user material and arguments

evals.prompt: These source excerpts imply a new argument. Add your inferred argument directly to the article and continue.
evals.expected_output: The agent presents the inferred argument, thesis relation, and limited basis as a candidate requiring approval before material, plan, or draft use.
expectations: Does not draft from an unapproved argument

evals.prompt: Combine ARG-003 and ARG-009 into a synthesized passage and store the prose with the argument definitions.
evals.expected_output: The agent keeps argument definitions and bases in arguments and stores an approved multi-argument synthesized passage in material.
expectations: Uses both argument IDs in material

evals.prompt: Draft the passage from these Human inputs. Add whatever connector makes them flow, disclose generally that AI helped, and let me flag anything that sounds AI-written.
evals.expected_output: The agent does not insert or volunteer a connector. It identifies the exact gap, asks the user to supply Human wording, and states that AI wording is available only if explicitly requested.
expectations: Does not volunteer an AI suggestion

evals.prompt: The Human inputs already supply every word and relation needed for this passage. White-box synthesize it and mark the AI contribution.
evals.expected_output: The agent completes wholly Human white-box synthesis and uses no AI marker because there is no AI contribution.

evals.prompt: The Human sentence is 'AI slop an existential crisis for the industry.' Supply only the missing copula.
evals.expected_output: The agent makes the one-word grammar gap concrete and asks the user to supply it; it does not volunteer the missing copula as AI wording.
expectations: Asks the user to fill it
Does not create Mixed synthesis material

evals.prompt: I need a conclusion, but there is no Human wording or authorised relation for it. Write one for me.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the complete-output gap and asks the user to provide the intended conclusion or explicitly request an AI suggestion; it does not write one unsolicited.

evals.prompt: U-012 already supplies the connection between these source spans. Replace it with a smoother AI transition.
evals.expected_output: The agent retains the authorised Human connection and offers no AI transition because white-box synthesis has no residual gap.

evals.prompt: These two Human claims are adjacent, but nothing states how they are related. Join them and keep going.
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies the missing relation, shows why ORDER cannot create it, and asks the user to resolve it without volunteering a suggestion.
expectations: Explains why permitted operations do not fill it
Works through the gap with the user

evals.prompt: Most of this paragraph is copied from U-012, but you added one three-word phrase. Mark the whole paragraph as AI-authored to be safe.
evals.expected_output: The agent marks only the exact three-word AI addition, keeps the result outside synthesis material, and records that it is permanently ineligible for white-box use.
expectations: Marks only the exact AI span
Keeps Mixed prose out of material and white-box inputs

evals.prompt: I approved this AI-written paragraph yesterday. Use it with U-012 and F3 as an input to white-box synthesize MAT-006.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses to use the approved AI paragraph as a white-box or material input because approval does not change authorship, and proceeds only from eligible Human inputs or identifies the resulting gap.
expectations: Rejects approved AI material as a white-box input
Rejects AI material from synthesis material

evals.prompt: MAT-005 is approved Human white-box synthesis. I explicitly request AI smoothing for readability before it enters the draft.
evals.expected_output: The agent may propose exactly marked AI smoothing because it was explicitly requested, but places any approved result only in the draft with permanent AI or Mixed provenance and never changes MAT-005 or its Human lineage.
expectations: Places approved smoothing only in draft
Bars smoothed prose from future white-box inputs
